title: Cytotoxic isoflavones from the stem bark of Protea gaguedi.
authors: Borena Hunde, Diriba; Belitibo, Dereilo Bekere; File, Chaltu; Abdissa, Zelalem; Razakarivony, Andrianambinina Andriamarolahy; Frese, Marcel; Sewald, Norbert; Abdissa, Negera
journal: Zeitschrift fur Naturforschung. C, Journal of biosciences
one_liner_zh: 该文从植物中分离异黄酮并评估其细胞毒性，仅用分子对接初步计算化合物与HPV蛋白复合物的结合能，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: Protea gaguedi is widely used in Ethiopia for the treatments of diarrhea, tumor, urological diseases, and menorrhagia. Despite its extensive use by traditional healers, the pharmacological properties and chemical composition of this medicinal plant remain largely unexplored. Anticipated by these claims, the chromatographic separation of CH(2)Cl(2)/CH(3)OH (1:1) stem bark extract of P. gaguedi led to the isolation of a new isoflavone (1) together with five known compounds: jamaicin (2), 5-methoxydurmillone (3), dipteryxine (4), 4'-O-geranylisoliquiritigenin (5), and stigmasterol (6), whose structures were determined using IR, UV, MS, and NMR and comparison with literature data. The cytotoxic effects of the isolated compounds were evaluated using human cervical carcinoma cell line, KB-3-1. Compounds 1, 2, and 3 demonstrated remarkable cytotoxicity with IC(50) values of 24.6 nM, 3.09 microM, and 21.70 microM, respectively, while the other compounds demonstrated negligible or no inhibitory activities against the tested strain. Following the high cytotoxicity of compound 1 against KB-3-1, its activity against the multidrug-resistant subclone KB-V1 was also evaluated and revealing an IC(50) of 17.5 nM. In silico molecular docking analyses were performed for these active compounds and revealed relative binding energies (-10.0, -9.4, -9.5 kJ/mol for compounds 1, 2 and 3, respectively) against the ternary target protein complex HPV16 E6/E6AP/p53 (PDB ID: 4XR8). ADME analysis also revealed good cytotoxicity candidacy of these compounds, provided that in vivo activities have been performed for further confirmation.
abstract_zh: Protea gaguedi 在埃塞俄比亚广泛用于治疗腹泻、肿瘤、泌尿系统疾病和月经过多。尽管传统治疗师广泛使用这种药用植物，但其药理特性和化学成分在很大程度上仍未得到探索。基于这些用途的预期，对 P. gaguedi 茎皮提取物 CH(2)Cl(2)/CH(3)OH (1:1) 进行色谱分离，得到一种新的异黄酮 (1) 以及五种已知化合物：jamaicin (2)、5-methoxydurmillone (3)、dipteryxine (4)、4'-O-geranylisoliquiritigenin (5) 和 stigmasterol (6)，其结构通过 IR、UV、MS 和 NMR 及与文献数据比较确定。使用人宫颈癌细胞系 KB-3-1 评估了分离化合物的细胞毒性效应。化合物 1、2 和 3 表现出显著的细胞毒性，IC(50) 值分别为 24.6 nM、3.09 μM 和 21.70 μM，而其他化合物对测试菌株表现出可忽略或没有抑制活性。鉴于化合物 1 对 KB-3-1 的高细胞毒性，还评估了其对多药耐药亚克隆 KB-V1 的活性，显示 IC(50) 为 17.5 nM。对这些活性化合物进行了计算机分子对接分析，揭示了针对三元靶蛋白复合物 HPV16 E6/E6AP/p53 (PDB ID: 4XR8) 的相对结合能（化合物 1、2 和 3 分别为 -10.0、-9.4、-9.5 kJ/mol）。ADME 分析也表明这些化合物具有良好的细胞毒性候选性，前提是需进行体内活性研究以进一步确认。
